description: This Java source file defines a Wear OS watch face service that displays the user's daily distance total from Google Fit. It manages GoogleApiClient connections, subscribes to distance data updates, and renders time and distance information on the watch face, adapting to ambient mode and device properties.

classes.name: FitDistanceWatchFaceService
classes.description: A service that provides a watch face displaying time and Google Fit distance data.

classes.name: FitDistanceWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Engine class handling rendering, Google Fit data retrieval, and watch face behavior.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes paints, GoogleApiClient, registers broadcast receivers, and sets watch face style.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the time and total distance on the watch face, adapting for ambient mode.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles GoogleApiClient connection, triggers data subscription and retrieval.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the Google Fit daily total distance result, updating display data.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Schedules or cancels periodic time updates based on current mode.

methods.name: getTotalDistance
methods.description: Initiates Google Fit API call to retrieve the total distance for the day.

methods.name: subscribeToDistance
methods.description: Sets up subscription to Google Fit distance data updates.
